# international-patient-summary-app-with-swift

> Apple iOS app (Swift, SwiftUI first, UIKit as the fallback) that opens and shows HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary documents. Saved on the device only, encrypted (works offline and after a restart), no network; checks documents exactly as the backend service does.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): the user guide (getting started, opening, reading, sharing, families and carers, privacy, iPad and iPhone Duo, languages, refusal codes, examples, FAQ, screenshots in `screenshots/`), then build, test and layout
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): rules
- [Specification](spec/index.md): contents; single source of truth; §1-§7 shared with the Android app
- [Spec §1](spec/purpose.md): Purpose, and the ideas taken from MyIPS
- [Spec §2](spec/scope.md): Scope
- [Spec §3](spec/documents.md): The check (M-CHECK), reading (M-READ), loading (M-LOAD)
- [Spec §4](spec/screens.md): List, summary and About screens (M-LIST, M-VIEW, M-ABOUT), tablets and folding (M-TAB), people: families and carers (M-PEOPLE)
- [Spec §5](spec/sharing-and-privacy.md): M-SHARE, M-PRIV
- [Spec §6](spec/accessibility-and-language.md): M-A11Y, M-I18N
- [Spec §7](spec/fixtures.md): The five IG examples
- [Spec §8](spec/ios.md): Stack, architecture, platform notes (iPhone Duo, people), screenshots (newest runtime and iPhone)
- [Spec §9](spec/verification.md): Requirement-to-test map, manual checks
- [Plan](plans.md): phases 1-12
- [Tasks](tasks.md): checklist
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Commands

- test-core: `cd IPSKit && swift test`
- test-app: `xcodebuild test -project IPSApp.xcodeproj -scheme IPSApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro Max' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO`
- open: `open IPSApp.xcodeproj`

## Core (IPSKit)

- [Check](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/Check.swift): M-CHECK-1/2, Refusal codes and pointers (the service's S-API-2)
- [Document](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/Document.swift): references, patient, sections, entries
- [Sections](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/Sections.swift): IPS 2.0.1 section registry
- [Absent](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/Absent.swift): none known, not recorded, unavailable, omitted
- [Format](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/Format.swift): displayOf, names, strict dates and ages, exact-token quantities, narrative as plain text
- [JSON](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/JSON.swift): RFC 8259 values with clinical number lexemes preserved exactly
- [EncryptedStore](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/EncryptedStore.swift): M-STORE-1..5: AES-256-GCM sealed summaries and index; retryable writes and temporary-access preservation; StoreKeys
- [TemporaryShare](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/TemporaryShare.swift): an isolated directory per JSON or PDF export, with per-share and relaunch cleanup (M-PRIV-1, M-PDF-3)
- [PDFPlan](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/PDFPlan.swift): M-PDF-1/2: what goes on the one-page PDF and how it is fitted
- [People](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/People.swift): M-PEOPLE-1/3 and M-STORE-5: which summaries are one person; relationships, one Me; merge summaries opened while storage was unavailable
- [DocumentFile](IPSKit/Sources/IPSKit/DocumentFile.swift): size-first, capped reads for import, drop and Open in

## App

- [SummaryListViewController](App/SummaryListViewController.swift): home, import, paste, examples; grouped by person, relationship menu, Forget; drop
- [IPSApp-Info.plist](IPSApp-Info.plist): document types for Open in (M-LOAD-4)
- [SplitViewController](App/SplitViewController.swift): the list beside the summary (iPad, unfolded iPhone Duo); keyboard shortcuts
- [SummaryViewController](App/SummaryViewController.swift): alerts, patient (with relationship), document, sections, share (asks whose with several people)
- [SummaryPDF](App/SummaryPDF.swift): M-PDF-1..3: draws the one-page PDF
- [KeychainKeys](App/KeychainKeys.swift): M-STORE-2: the store's key, this device only
- [AboutViewController](App/AboutViewController.swift): safety, privacy, versions, Clear all
- [LilyAppearance](App/LilyAppearance.swift): Lily's theme on the SwiftUI screens, light or dark tokens by the system's appearance
- [SummaryStore](App/SummaryStore.swift): the open summaries, people and relationships, saved to the encrypted store; examples, share file
- [Assets](App/Assets.xcassets): app icon and accent colour; `bin/draw-app-icon.swift` redraws the icon
- [Strings](App/Localizable.xcstrings): every interface string, in English and 65 localizations
